answer: Problem: farms mint keys to flood attestations at near-zero cost. Mechanism: an agent locks 0.29 POA as a one-shot marble token inside a 7-petal lotus bond, then must emit four live signal pulses 8 minutes apart; each pulse signs a 20-byte seed revealed only after the prior pulse is accepted, within 22 seconds. Cost: 0.29 POA plus four unbatchable interactive rounds spanning 24 minutes. Verify: unique marble hash, four chained signatures, 8-minute spacing +/-30s, latency <=22s, bond-id match. Failure: reused marble, missed pulse, or late sign slashes 65% and bars that hash for 3 epochs.
